purpose: Show that the assertion pass rate does not track macro-F1 across configurations, with and without the added A4a assertion.
encodings: two scatter panels side by side sharing the y axis; left: joint pass rate of A1, A2, A3; right: joint pass rate with A4a added; each point one of the 12 configurations, colored by sentiment model (fixed order cardiff, distilbert, siebert, tabularisai), marker shape by ASR; annotate each panel with Pearson and Spearman from Milestone2/T1_final/results/correlations.json (keys A123 and A123_A4a)

axes.x: share of test clips passing all assertions

caption: Assertion pass rate against macro-F1 over 12 configurations. Left: A1-A3 only (Pearson -0.24). Right: with the classifier-agreement assertion A4a (Pearson -0.08). Pass rate is tuned per configuration, so it says nothing about which configuration is better.
